walkthroughs.body_html:
Experimenting with Music — a core area of Music.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Experimenting with Music brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Experimenting with Music.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is the function of the bridge in a pop song?
options: It is the very first section.
To provide contrast before the final chorus, often by changing melody, key, or texture.
Loud music with many instruments.
It is the same as the chorus.
